description: This Java source file defines the class PolicyModifySignalMapper, which extends AbstractModifySignalMapper, and provides specific implementations for enhancing payloads and constructing topic paths for PolicyModifyCommand objects within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter signals framework.

classes.name: PolicyModifySignalMapper
classes.description: A final class that maps PolicyModifyCommand objects to signals within the protocol adapter, providing methods to enhance payloads and generate topic paths.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the payload builder with the value from the policy modify command, fetching the entity for the current schema version.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Constructs and returns a TopicPathBuilder positioned at the policies path for the specific entity ID associated with the command.
